code: foreach(var l in UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsByType<Light>(FindObjectsSortMode.None).Where(l=>l.gameObject.scene.name=="Safehouse")){if(l.name=="Bulb"){l.intensity=8;l.range=9;l.color=new Color(1,.86f,.7f);}if(l.name=="PracticalLight"){l.intensity=6;l.range=6;l.color=new Color(1,.86f,.7f);}}return "Existing local lights strengthened for night readability";
